correctness.rationale: The coefficient-quotient basis is exact of dimension 16; all 65,536 classes are exhaustively tested for rational Jacobian rank. The 288 survivors split under explicit symplectic transvections into exactly two orbits of 144. Groebner chart unit-ideal tests certify one orbit geometrically smooth and the other geometrically singular. Exhaustive pairwise tangent comparisons give the stated nine-stratum histogram and no pair with zero overlap. Complete 288-matchings enumeration and disjointness adjacency give a graph with 36 eight-vertex components, each a cross-orbit 8-cycle plus a singular-orbit 4-cycle. Shared tangency iff the sum is singular at that point follows from exact characteristic-two differentiation; no finite sampling is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: For minimal-degree algebraic space-filling curves, existence of an all-smooth pencil is a natural finite-field Bertini question not answered by a single-curve existence/census. The exact obstruction says no two smooth sections can be completed with their sum, identifies rational singular witnesses through common tangent flags, and organizes all 288 tangent assignments into 36 octagonal components with 4-cycle chords, including a maximal intersecting 144-family. The result is motivated geometric structure, not a tabulation of arbitrary coefficients.
